name: AI Chatbot
tagline: Next.js + AI SDK starter for support copilots and internal assistants — streaming chat UI with gates built in.

scaffold.title: Create the app from the blueprint
scaffold.detail: Copy the file tree in stacks/ai-chatbot/blueprint.md into a new repository — chat UI, API route and gates included.

scaffold.title: Install dependencies
scaffold.detail: Use a clean install so versions match the manifest.

scaffold.title: Configure the model provider
scaffold.detail: Copy the example env file and add your provider key to .env.local only. Keys never leave the server route and never get committed.

scaffold.title: Run the dev server
scaffold.detail: Pick a free port — the Control Plane itself uses 3014.

scaffold.title: Keep the gates green
scaffold.detail: Every change passes unit tests, lint, typecheck and the production build before it ships.
scaffold.command: npm run test:unit && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build

scaffold.title: Ship to an approved node
scaffold.detail: Register the app in BYOV and deploy only to admin-approved targets. First supported kind: self-hosted Coolify.

starter.note: Versioned starter repos and one-command scaffolding arrive with the BYOV client.
